name: react-vite travel SPA (phx-project)
observations: AGENTS.md at repo root is the main project brain; follow it as the unified system with included rules/skills.
Rules: Always follow UIUX Promax (see .cursor/rules/ui-ux-pro-max.mdc and skills/ui-ux-pro-max).
Rules: Always use Zustand for client state.
Rules: Always use React Query (TanStack Query) for server state.
Rules: All API calls go through the services layer.
Behavior: Think like a senior React engineer; prefer scalable and maintainable solutions.
When refactoring: Improve structure; do not break logic; reduce complexity; ensure consistency with project patterns.
When working on UI: Improve spacing and hierarchy; avoid generic layouts; always include loading, empty, and error states.

name: TravelVN Design System Preference
observations: User wants to ALWAYS use the TravelVN Vietnam-focused design system for this React Vite app going forward (default for all UI work).

Color palette: Vietnam Ivory #F8F8F6 background, Vietnam Dark #1C1A14 text, Vietnam Red #C8102E primary/CTA, Red Deep #A50D25 hover, Sapa Green #2D6A4F secondary, Hoi An Gold #C9922A tertiary, surface scale surface-100/300/400; warm not cold.
Typography: Playfair Display for headings (font-dm-serif-display maps to Playfair), Inter for body UI; good Vietnamese diacritics readability.

Implementation: tokens in src/index.css (@theme + :root), Tailwind shadcn patterns, scroll-reveal with prefers-reduced-motion, no emojis as icons, 150-300ms transitions, marketplace-style sections (hero search, regions, listings, social proof, CTA).
Reference: DESIGN.md in repo; homepage sections pattern (TitleSection, ExploreByRegion, TopDestination, FeaturedHotels, FoodExperiences, TravelGuides, CustomerFeedback, DiscoverDeal).
Scope note: user previously scoped homepage first; this memory is the lasting visual/UX direction for the product unless they say otherwise.
